description: C54 — 意大利开局，连接双车的三步曲

intro.popup_en: Connecting the Rooks, Lesson 1: The opening sequence has three steps: develop the minor pieces, castle, then clear the back rank so the rooks connect. Each move should serve a useful purpose.
intro.popup:
链接双车第1课
开局三步曲：
①出动所有轻子
②国王易位
③底线清空→双车连接！
每一步都自然，每一步都有价值！

outro.popup_en: Be3, Nbd2, and Qe2 clear the back rank in three natural moves. Rfe1 completes the connection. Remember this pattern; connecting the rooks is a standard opening goal.
outro.popup:
总结：Be3+Nbd2+Qe2 = 三步清空底线
Rfe1！双车连接完成！
记住这个模式——这是每局棋都要做到的！

moves.popup_en: Nf3! White develops the first minor piece. The three-step process begins with developing the pieces.
moves.popup:
Nf3！轻子出动第1步
三步曲启动：发展轻子！

moves.popup_en: Bc4! White develops the second minor piece in the Italian Game and controls the center.
moves.popup:
Bc4！轻子出动第2步
意大利开局：控制中心！

moves.popup_en: O-O! White completes the second step by castling. The back rank still has pieces between the rooks, so they are not yet connected.
moves.popup:
O-O！易位完成！三步曲第二步！
底线：Ra1-Nb1-Bc1-Qd1-[e1]-Rf1-Kg1
还需清空方可连接！

moves.popup_en: Be3!! The bishop develops naturally from c1 to e3 and clears c1. The back rank is one step closer to being open.
moves.popup:
Be3！！关键一步！
Bc1→e3 自然发展象，同时清空c1！
底线：Ra1-Nb1-[c1空]-Qd1-Rf1

moves.popup_en: fxe3 recaptures and leaves the e-file semi-open.
Bb3 retreats while maintaining the bishop's diagonal control.
moves.popup: Bb3象后撤，保持对角线控制

moves.popup_en: Nbd2! The knight develops naturally and clears b1. With b1 and c1 empty, only the queen remains between the rooks.
moves.popup:
Nbd2！马自然出动，清空b1！
底线：Ra1-[b1空]-[c1空]-Qd1-Rf1

moves.popup_en: Qe2!! The queen moves off d1 and clears the final square on the back rank. Everything is ready for Rfe1 to connect the rooks.
moves.popup:
Qe2！！后联结，清空d1！
底线：Ra1-[b1]-[c1]-[d1空]-Rf1
一切就绪！Rfe1即完成连接！

moves.popup_en: Rfe1!! The rooks are connected. The f1-rook moves to e1, and the back rank is clear between the rooks. The three-step pattern is complete: develop minor pieces, castle, then clear the back rank.
moves.popup:
Rfe1！！双车连接完成！
Rf1→e1，底线全部清空！
Ra1—[b1]—[c1]—[d1]—Re1
三步曲完成：①轻子出 ②易位 ③底线清空双车连接！比较协调的开局模式！
